verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a portal that holds users' tax data, so the axis applies. The pack shows no bulk export of account data in open formats. The closest items are tangential: an XML e-invoice viewer, PDF-only storage in "Meine Belege", printed transmission protocols, electronically delivered notices, and the option to file through third-party ELSTER-compatible software. None of these amounts to exporting all of one's data and leaving.
